title: Dinosaurs
examples: How do scientists know about dinosaurs?
What kind of food did T-Rex eat?

explain.say: Dinosaurs were reptiles that lived a very long time ago. Some were giant.
Scientists learn about them from fossils. Fossils are ancient bones and footprints turned to rock.

items: Its bones get covered by mud
Over time, they turn to rock

explain.say: Some dinosaurs ate plants. Others ate meat.
Then a big change happened on Earth, long before people lived. The big dinosaurs disappeared.
A bone found in rock might be a fossil. It shows what an ancient animal looked like.
Dinosaurs were not all one size. Some were as small as a chicken. Others were huge.

faq.q: Where do we find dinosaur fossils?
faq.a: We often find them in layers of rock deep underground. Scientists dig them up very carefully.
asks: Can you find dinosaur bones outside?

faq.a: No, some dinosaurs were plant eaters called herbivores. They ate things like ferns and leaves.
asks: What did the plant-eating dinosaurs eat?

faq.q: How long ago did the dinosaurs live?
faq.a: They lived millions of years ago, long before there were people.
A fossil is a preserved trace or imprint of something from the past. It can be bones or footprints.

faq.q: Why did the dinosaurs die out?
faq.a: The best idea is that a big asteroid hit the Earth. This changed the planet's climate suddenly.

facts: Dinosaurs were reptiles that lived millions of years ago.
Fossils are preserved remains of ancient life.
Herbivores eat only plants, while carnivores eat meat.
The extinction event changed Earth's climate.

quiz.say: A herbivore dinosaur looks for food. What does it eat?
quiz.why: Herbivores eat plants, like leaves and ferns.

wrong.2: Sand has no food in it, so no dinosaur ate it.

quiz.say: How do scientists learn about dinosaurs today?
quiz.show: 🦴 How do we know about dinosaurs?
quiz.why: Fossils are bones and footprints turned to rock. They show us how dinosaurs lived.

wrong.1: There were no cameras when dinosaurs lived.
wrong.2: Dinosaur films are made by artists, long after dinosaurs lived.

quiz.say: What do you call an animal that eats only meat?
quiz.why: A carnivore is an animal that eats meat.

wrong.1: Reptile names a kind of animal, like a lizard, and reptiles can eat plants or meat.
